description: N5/C2 pre-implementation design challenge (derived human + agent activity)

no_authority_confusion.instructions: The derived activity design cannot become authoritative healthcare state and offers no path that mutates source-domain state (appointments, encounters, prescriptions, orders, results, claims, payments, eligibility, authorizations, staff authority, patient clinical facts)

criteria.true: Activity is derived-only and append-only, holds no handle to a domain store, and exposes no write-back path
criteria.false: Some read or write path lets activity own, overwrite or mutate authoritative domain state

privacy_controls.instructions: The payload controls are sufficient to stop PHI, clinical narrative and credential material from entering a stored activity record

criteria.true: Closed key allowlist, flat bounded string values, size bound, and refusal of secret/credential and clinical-content patterns cover the realistic leak vectors for a metadata feed
criteria.false: A realistic input can still persist PHI, clinical narrative, secrets or tokens in an activity record

tenant_isolation.instructions: The tenant and branch controls prevent cross-tenant leakage and cross-branch over-visibility on both the projection path and the read path

criteria.true: Projection refuses foreign tenants and reads are tenant- and branch-scoped with deny-by-default membership
criteria.false: A caller can project into or read from a tenant or branch it does not belong to

agent_attribution.instructions: The design prevents an agent actor from acquiring or implying authority it does not hold, including after suspension, revocation or sponsor loss

criteria.true: Agent activity must reference a real bounded identity, and historical activity is annotated so it never implies current authority
criteria.false: Historical or unattributed agent activity can be read as a current grant of authority

replay_safety.instructions: The deduplication key and conflict behaviour make at-least-once redelivery of canonical events deterministic and non-duplicating

criteria.true: Uniqueness on tenant plus source domain plus source event id plus projection version, with a content-conflict refusal, handles replay and divergence
criteria.false: A replayed or divergent canonical event creates duplicate or silently rewritten activity history

residual_implementation_risk.instructions: How much residual risk remains in this design before it is safe to implement as a bounded synthetic slice
